title: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini
description:
I gave ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini the exact same research brief, then opened every source and scored all three reports on one 100-point rubric.

This video shows which AI produced the most defensible decision brief, where each one failed, and a repeatable way to choose the right AI for research work.

The job: prepare a source-grounded brief for a five-person creative agency considering a four-day workweek. I scored each report on coverage, factual accuracy, source quality, citation integrity, and decision usefulness.

THE RESULTS
ChatGPT: 96/100
Claude: 89/100
Gemini: 65/100

#ChatGPT #ClaudeAI #GoogleGemini #bestaitools2026 #gemini
